lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: I can't see shit!

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: I told you before, you have to--

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Clear my mind of all other thoughts. Yeah, primo advice.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Might as well ask me to herd *star-knoss*...

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: I'm going to assume those are similar to *cats*.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Oh, no, they eat cats...

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Exclusively.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Me-Dammit, I want to watch this stupid fight!

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: Tell me - what thoughts are clouding your mind?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: [in Dende's head] Hey, Dende. Could you put this lotion on my back and/or butt?

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Mmm... God stuff.

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: Well, worry not. All we really need is a little green.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: I specifically told you not to call me that.

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: I'm not~

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Yo...

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: My God...

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: What feats of incomparable skill and might! What power! What *speed*! What. A. *Battle*!-- Is what I'd be saying if they were in the ring...

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Where are they?

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Maybe they're moving at speeds too fast for the human eye?

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: I could try using the high shutter camera...

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Jerry, you're a terrific camera guy, but a *lousy* martial artist.

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Nobody's that fast! They're just using camouflage - like the Predator!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Or Harry Potter.

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: ...Harry Potter, sir?

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: My daughter's a big fan.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Good, Goku, very good. This is exactly what I've been looking for!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh, you know... when I became perfect, I was a little scared.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Scared that I'd never be able to test these abilities.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Like a master surgeon without a patient.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Or a grill without a burger.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Yes, you get it, Goku! And that's why we're here today.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You are the only one who can complete me; compete with me!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: All the others? Ah, they mean nothing!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: This tournament, this ring; they're all for you.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: So we could have our perfect battle.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, honestly, you didn't need to go this far. I'm just here for a fight.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: God, that's what I adore about you. You're so simple!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: That's what nobody else understands...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Now then... how about we slip into something more... comfortable?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wait, I'm confused... are you asking me to get naked?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'Cause I'm not gonna say no, but I shouldn't say yes...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh crap, guy--!

lines.speaker: Everyone Else
lines.text: YAAAAAA--!!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Heh, looks like there's a *hole* in the *ring*!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha--!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: ...Really?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Let me cope!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: (Whimpering)

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Th-tha-thank you for saving us, M-M-Mister, uh...

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Sixteen.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Android 16.

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Anything you'd like to say to the audience?

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: I want to murder Son Goku.

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Well, you heard it here first, folks.

lines.speaker: Random Viewer
lines.text: Yeah, f**k Goku!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I'd feel worse about all the time I spent making our perfect ring, but now that it's gone...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: we can *fight unabated*!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Chi-Chi told me that makes you grow hair on your eyes.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Killing you will be the hardest thing I ever enjoy.

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Sir, what's our life insurance policy?

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Same as our ethics policy!

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Then I'm real glad I don't have a family!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Huh... what's he doing up there? Ooh, you think he's going for a Solar Flare?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Kaaaa...!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: That's *not* how the Solar Flare works!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: He-- he can't be serious...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ...Meeeee...!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Gettin' Dad flashbacks here!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ...HAAAA...!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Hu, hu-ha-ha-ha, I see!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Yes, Goku! You're absolutely *right*!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: This *is* the only way it can end!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: This tournament, these fools, this *planet*...! They mean *nothing* to men like you and I!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: We will go out together... in a ball of molten *rock* and *death*!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ...MEEEE...!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: GOKU, *NO*!!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: *YEESSSS*~!!
POP

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: ...Oh... crapbask*eeeEEEE*--!!!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ...*HAAAAAAAAAAAAAA*!!!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Larry! Are you alive?!

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Somehow, sir.

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Then *get back out there*, Larry!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Ha! Well those guys with the camera better stop rolling, 'cause looks like Cell's going topless! Hu-ha!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: You know, just because everyone somehow survived this... I'm gonna let you have that.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I won't; you suck!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: God as my witness... It looks like that orange hillbilly has exploded the top of Cell!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Mr. Satan, do you have *any* explanations?

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Well, if I were a bettin' man - and I am, it's a serious problem - they *combined* the lasers *and* the mirrors *with C4 charges*--

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: And switched the body out in the ensuing chaos!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: *Now* you're thinking like a Satanist, Jimmy.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Awesome. Hey Krillin, can I get a ten-count?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You got it, Goku!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: ONE!
Slide Whistle

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Twoooo...!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: All right, time! Timeout! Time *right* the hell out!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: How did you--?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You weren't here for this, but TL;DR... Piccolo's cells.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Okay, I am... 90% sure I can't do that.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: We'll figure *that* out later.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: In the meantime, what I really want to know is how *you* keep popping in and out of reality!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh, that's just my Instant Transmission.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And don't tell me, is that another technique you stole?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: No... kinda... I got it from eating sick aliens...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: That's disgusting.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: *You eat people all the time*!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Yes. And I'm a monster.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Yeah, with all our stolen DNA.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I DIDN'T ASK TO BE BORN, *DADS*!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Mr. Satan, can you make heads or tails of this?

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Because right now, I'm more confused than a homeless man under house arrest!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: First of all; I find that offensive.

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Secondly, uh...

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: I don't want to give away *all* the trade secrets! Otherwise, what would be left for the kids, Jimmy?

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: What would be left for the *kids*?

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: Pragmatism at its finest, Mr. Satan.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Hey, I'm here. Sorry I'm so late; I had to pick up Trunks from Daycare.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Ahh... you brought the baby...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Is that a problem?

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Uhh--... naw, it's fine.

lines.speaker: Turtle
lines.text: He is legally obligated to inform you that he is--

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Turtle, I've watched her poop! She knows what I'm about.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I'll admit, Goku, I'm impressed.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: A blast that strong should've wiped you, but here you are, still swinging away at me!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Cell... if I gained *anything* in the days leading up to this tournament, it was endurance.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: AAH-TUUH!

lines.speaker: Ox King
lines.text: What did you do to him??

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: What *didn't* I do to him?

lines.speaker: Ox King
lines.text: You're just like your mother.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: This is bad. The last time I saw Goku this winded, he was having a heart attack.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: He can't keep this up.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Wait! What about the Senzu Beans?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: You know - the magical beans that... heal all wounds and... restore your... stamina...?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Okay, guys, if you're bothered by cheating, either loosen your moral code or stop hinging the fate of the world on *deathmatches*!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I can't believe you're my son.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Hey, you said it, not me.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Kakarot isn't *like you*; he's a full-blooded Saiyan warrior!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: He'd throw that Senzu Bean back in your face, because it's not the world that's at stake...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I'm pretty sure it is--

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: ...It's his *Saiyan pride*!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: He'll see this fight to the end without any of our help.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Even if it *kills* him.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I give up.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: *I'LL KILL HIM*!!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'm rather high up here.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: What did you just say, Goku?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I give up! You win! Great fight!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Wait, what is he doing?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Well, this is your father, so he's either saving all of our lives or dooming us all.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: But we're not finished.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: *I'm* not finished!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: This isn't a victory; this is... I don't even know *what* this is!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Nah, it's totally a victory. 'Cause I'm giving up. That means you win.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Every word you just spoke has made me violently angry (!)

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Every word you just spoke has made me violently angry (!)

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: OH, GREAT! NOW I'M AGREEING WITH VEGETA!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: OH, GREAT! NOW I'M AGREEING WITH CELL!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: LOOK WHAT YOU MADE ME DO!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: LOOK WHAT YOU MADE ME DO!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Cell, you knew what this was...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Just a fight. Nothing more.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You bitch (!)

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: If you seriously concede, I'll... I'll just blow up the Earth like I said!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: So unless you want me to turn this whole planet into an *asteroid field*, *Kakarot*, GET BACK UP HERE AND PUNCH ME IN MY PERFECT JAWLINE!!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hold your horses, Cell. You said this was a tournament.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: There's still a fighter left to take you on, so you'll have to fight him first.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh...? Oh, ohoho, I see...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: This is a *prank*!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: My God, I honestly never figured you for a prankster, Goku, but you *son of a bitch*, ya *got* me!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Okay, who is it? Is it the Prince?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: No, it couldn't be; I don't even take my *own* sloppy seconds.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: The boy?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Hardly; he looks like he's about ready to crush coal into diamonds with his sphincter.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh, could it be Tenshinhan? Please tell me it's Tenshinhan.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Man, it's like a hate boner triangle.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Nope-a-rino! The fighter I've selected... the fighter who will finally put your terror to an end, is~...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Mr. Satan! Get out here, you!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: DIARRHEA!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, shoot. Original plan, then.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Gohan, get out here!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I'm sorry, we're a little high up here. What did he just say, Mr. Piccolo?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I think he just said--

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: *Gohan*?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Out of the entire list, you pick... *him*?!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: He wasn't even *on the list*!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: *YAMCHA was on the list*!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Wait, why was I--?!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Half-time entertainment!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Frankly, I'm just happy to be included.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Alright, Gohan. He's all yours. Have fun!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Dad, I'm going to have to politely ask you to back the HFIL up.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: What... in Dende's name... are you *doing*?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'm sending in the strongest fighter we got.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: *This* is what you trained for.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: T-That's what *you* trained for! *I* was never supposed to fight! I was just there to make you stronger!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh Gohan, you're just being insincere.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Insecure; and *no, he's not*! HE'S ELEVEN YEARS OLD!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Goku, we're not going to tell you how to be a parent right now--

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I AM!!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: --but how do you think *Chi-Chi* is going to react to this?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: *I am going to castrate him*...!

lines.speaker: Ox King
lines.text: (Wheezing in fright)

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Guys, trust me on this one. I spent a *whole year* training him last week.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: So get out there, Gohan! You got this.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Do I even have a choice?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'Course you do!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You either go out there and kill him, or the planet gets exploded.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: That's not a choice, *that's* an ultimatum.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Gohan... we *both* know I don't know what that word means.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Obviously not.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Haaa, OK, fine, I'll go fight Cell...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I've never been wished back by the Dragon, so hey, this'll be a learning experience...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Gohan, wait. Before you go...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ...you're so much stronger than you think you are.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Yeah, well, let's see what Cell thinks.

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: My *goodness*!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: The orange hillbilly, previously reported to BEAT HIS WIFE, has resigned himself, and *sent his own child to fight Cell*!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: ...With a BUTTER KNIFE, you son of a BITCH!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: I'll tie you to a chair first, and gag you with a GODDAMN DAIKON RADISH!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: So, the biggest, most important fight of my life walks away, and sends in the world's strongest bookworm!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Fine. Goku, I'll play along with this little joke.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: But I want you to know - while I'm busy *pounding your son*... I'll be thinking of you the entire time.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'Thinking about it, I might actually have the advantage here.'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'He took as much of a beating as Dad did, if not more.'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'And after spending a year with Dad in that Time Chamber, I'm at least as strong as he is now.'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'And then, if I play it carefully, I could actually win this!'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh - hey Krillin? Can you bean me real quick?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh sure, here.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Thanks, friend. Hey, Cell!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Senzu Bean!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: *WHAT*!?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: What? I'm just playing fair. He's tired. He's got post-Goku exhaustion.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: *Dad*! He is going to *kill me*!!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Hey, you said it, not me.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: OH, THAT'S THAT *GOOD SHIT*!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Suck it kale, you bush-league super food.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'Well, war of attrition is out; so, deep end it is...'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: HAAAAAAAAAA...!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Which one was it, Goku?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: *Which concussion did you suffer* that made you think *ANY* of this was a good idea!?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Piccolo, just watch.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You're going to see amazing things out there.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: What's amazing about watching your 11-year-old son get murdered?(!)

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Gohan might be 11 years old, but he's also like, I dunno, a hundred times *stronger* than I was at that age!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Goku...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: He's been keeping pace with us since he was a baby.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I mean, you should know. You kidnapped him.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: *Goku*...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And after spending that year alone with him, I know more than *anyone* that he's going to--

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: GOKU!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: What!?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Thinkin' o' you, Goku!

lines.speaker: Jimmy
lines.text: ...previously reported to BEAT HIS WIFE, has resigned himself, and *sent his own child to fight Cell*!

lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: Hm... sweet hair.
